_note: Self-heal (owner request 02/11/2026): retries = automatic re-runs of a failed run (only its failed jobs), after waits of backoff_s[0], backoff_s[1] seconds. Then autofix: an LLM reads the log and proposes a code fix (PR, merged only if safe). Workflows not listed here are never re-run nor fixed (launch9, threads-delete, tiktok-auth, backup-llm-check: one-off, interactive or destructive). The list must match 'workflows:' in .github/workflows/self-heal.yml.
_note_known: Known failures (owner 04/11/2026: 'il sistema si deve autorisolvere'): after the normal retries, the first pattern found in the failed log picks fixed repairs: the workflows in 'before' (started and awaited), then a re-run after each wait in waits_s. Not counted in the autofix limits. code_fix=false: no LLM autofix afterwards (nothing to change in the code), the issue says what is left to the owner.
